practice: Rosiglitazone (Avandia/Avandamet) boxed warning language on cardiovascular risk
old_label_text: A meta-analysis of 42 clinical studies (mean duration 6 months; 14,237 total patients)... showed rosiglitazone to be associated with an increased risk of myocardial ischemic events such as angina or myocardial infarction.
new_label_text: A meta-analysis of 52 clinical trials (mean duration 6 months; 16,995 total patients)... showed rosiglitazone to be associated with an increased risk of myocardial infarction.
source: DailyMed SPL history, AVANDAMET (rosiglitazone maleate + metformin), SETID 0789dc6b-db34-44a6-8a5d-fdcc8e4ce8fd, versions 2 and 6 -- https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/services/v2/spls/0789dc6b-db34-44a6-8a5d-fdcc8e4ce8fd/history.json
provenance_note: Zero LLM involvement -- literal FDA-regulated Structured Product Label (SPL) text pulled via DailyMed's official version-history API and diffed directly. Boxed-warning title itself changed from 'MYOCARDIAL ISCHEMIA' to 'MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION' between versions, and the underlying meta-analysis evidence base was updated (42 studies/14,237 patients -> 52 trials/16,995 patients), reflecting the post-2007 Nissen-controversy label revisions. This directly matches pilot concept C0289313 (rosiglitazone), already used in OGDA and Gate 2 experiments -- upgrades that concept's ground truth from LLM-only to Gold-tier.

practice: Combined estrogen+progestin HRT (Prempro/Premphase) boxed warning on cardiovascular disease and dementia prevention
old_label_text: CARDIOVASCULAR AND OTHER RISKS: Estrogens plus progestins should not be used for the prevention of cardiovascular disease or dementia... The WHI reported increased risks of myocardial infarction, stroke, invasive breast cancer, pulmonary emboli, and deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in postmenopausal women (50-79) during 5.6 years of treatment.
new_label_text: Estrogen Plus Progestin Therapy Cardiovascular Disorders and Probable Dementia: Estrogen plus progestin therapy should not be used for the prevention of cardiovascular disease or dementia... increased risk of DVT, PE, stroke and MI in postmenopausal women (50-79) during 5.6 years of treatment.
source: DailyMed SPL history, PREMPRO/PREMPHASE (conjugated estrogens + medroxyprogesterone acetate), SETID fd0c0836-5d23-2183-da81-9dc7f4287052, versions 3 and 39 -- https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/services/v2/spls/fd0c0836-5d23-2183-da81-9dc7f4287052/history.json
provenance_note: Zero LLM involvement. Both pulled versions already reflect the post-2002 Women's Health Initiative (WHI) reversal (the trial itself predates DailyMed's earliest indexed version for this SETID), so this specific pair documents refinement/restructuring of the warning over 17 years rather than a pre/post-WHI diff -- still real, dated, FDA-regulated evidence directly relevant to pilot concept C0282402 (hormone replacement therapy), and demonstrates the puller generalizes beyond the rosiglitazone case. A genuine pre/post-WHI diff would need an earlier SETID/version not available via this drug's current DailyMed history.

practice: Estrogen-alone HRT (Estrogel/estradiol) boxed warning on cardiovascular disease, dementia, and endometrial cancer risk
old_label_text: Close clinical surveillance...CARDIOVASCULAR AND OTHER RISKS: Estrogens with or without progestins should not be used for the prevention of cardiovascular disease...The estrogen-alone substudy of the WHI reported increased risks of stroke and DVT...during 6.8 and 7.1 years.
new_label_text: Estrogen-Alone Therapy Endometrial Cancer: There is an increased risk of endometrial cancer...Cardiovascular Disorders and Probable Dementia: The WHI estrogen-alone substudy reported increased risks of stroke and DVT...during 7.1 years...WHIMS reported an increased risk of developing probable dementia.
source: DailyMed SPL history, ESTROGEL (estradiol gel), SETID 762ac371-bb8b-47e7-b48f-e80d452c9dd4, versions 1 and 55 -- https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/services/v2/spls/762ac371-bb8b-47e7-b48f-e80d452c9dd4/history.json

Third real DailyMed diff, second HRT product (different from Prempro/Premphase), confirming the puller and the underlying WHI-driven label evolution generalize across multiple estrogen products, not just one brand. 2008 version already reflects the post-2002 WHI findings (predates the puller's earliest coverage for this SETID); the 2026 version adds explicit dementia-risk framing (WHIMS) and endometrial cancer restructuring not present in 2008 -- real, dated, ongoing label evolution.
